digest.component_or_area: tests/external/live_jira_dc test fixtures and conftest module structure
propositions: conftest.py exceeds the 800 LOC hard cap at 932 lines and must be split without breaking the monkeypatch surface used by unit tests that load it by path

monkeypatching a conftest name only reaches callers in conftest's own globals, so moving a patched function or its patched-through callers silently un-stubs the network and causes unit tests to issue live HTTP
the J11 store-copy/DC-client fixture cluster (dc_transport, dc_store_copy_repo, bound_dc_issue) is a safe extraction seam because it is a cohesive call-graph cluster not referenced by unit tests

extracted fixtures must be re-exported into conftest's namespace so pytest still collects them from conftest, and base URL must be threaded via a new jira_dc_base_url fixture to avoid duplicating the _BASE constant
regression tests must verify the by-path-loaded conftest still exposes the fixture surface and that all monkeypatched names remain defined in conftest, not merely re-exported
